name: LightImage Precomputation
definition: Precomputation of light segment portions of integrals into a 2D LightImage texture to accelerate single and multiple scattering computation, assuming static light and volume density.
summary: LightImage Precomputation accelerates multiple scattering by storing light visibility in a 2D texture, differing from its parent method by using orthographic projection instead of 3D light-segment integrals.
